title: Subscription-Only Auto Run CEO — zero-API-budget auto-policy, canonical autonomous Executor/Route supply, provable SUBSCRIPTION/UNMETERED cost binding, in-transaction autonomous dispatch gate, truthful readiness, production opt-in wiring
description: Subscription-only P15.10 autonomous Objective pipeline (opt-in PAIR_OBJECTIVE_AUTO_DRIVER=1, default OFF). A) auto-policy accepts budget_microusd_cap=0 as explicit hard zero-spend; invalid values still FAIL_CLOSED_POLICY_LIMITS; Objective ceiling=0 stays a hard OBJECTIVE_ZERO_BUDGET block in readiness. B) AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTOR_IDS=[CODEX,PAIR_NATIVE] is the only autonomous set; driver dispatchSupply derives pairings from LIVE executor rows (ENABLED/READY/QUALIFIED/auth/quota/rate) + QUALIFIED supply bindings + enabled never-rejected routes; serve-mission-control.mjs wires executors=AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTOR_IDS (was [...governed.keys()] — admitted disabled DEVIN, omitted PAIR_NATIVE) and seeds a SUBSCRIPTION codex profile only when undeclared. C) dispatchCostEnvelope: codex pairings prove $0 only via ACTIVE SUBSCRIPTION profile + provider AUTH_OK; UNMETERED/FREE on codex is contradictory → COST_BINDING_UNVERIFIED; SUBSCRIPTION without session → SUBSCRIPTION_AUTH_UNVERIFIED; UNKNOWN/unbounded → unprovable; METERED → bound math (positive caps) / METERED_ROUTE_FORBIDDEN under cap 0. D) assertAndReserve gates driver-attributed work (wob.created_by=DRIVER_ACTOR, moved to leaf work-open-binding.ts, breaking a cost→driver init cycle) in the same atomic txn: non-autonomous executor → FAIL_CLOSED_COST_AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTOR; cap=0+metered/unknown → FAIL_CLOSED_COST_AUTONOMOUS_METERED; manual missions and proven reservations never re-gated. F) readiness adds DRIVER_DISABLED, EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE, OBJECTIVE_ZERO_BUDGET, SUBSCRIPTION_AUTH_UNVERIFIED, METERED_ROUTE_FORBIDDEN. G) 30 focused regressions incl. production-composition E2E (fake codex CLI + recording adapters + real MissionControl): objective → wake → claim → admission → CEO → planner → governed dispatch → settled, zero metered API calls. Harness: r3/r4/p15-10c seed executor rows + reserve via autonomous ids; p15-10d/r1/met-branch-fold/p15-3/cpl1/p5 stay at exact win32 baselines.
